CCFUI.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable CCF-like UI
CCFUI.Settings.Enabled.Hint: When on: simplify the sidebar (each tab's visibility is configurable below), hide the left scene-controls toolbar, lock the canvas to Token-Select, and force Simple Message Window's toggle to always-on.
CCFUI.Settings.ApplyToGM.Name: Also apply to GM
CCFUI.Settings.ApplyToGM.Hint: By default the simplified UI is only applied to players. Turn this on to apply it to the GM account as well (useful for previewing what players see).
CCFUI.Settings.TabVisibility.Hint: When checked, this sidebar tab is shown in the CCF-like UI; uncheck to hide it. Controlled by the GM for all players. The Settings tab is always kept.
CCFUI.Settings.Tab.Chat.Name: Show sidebar tab: Chat
CCFUI.Settings.Tab.Combat.Name: Show sidebar tab: Combat
CCFUI.Settings.Tab.Scenes.Name: Show sidebar tab: Scenes
CCFUI.Settings.Tab.Actors.Name: Show sidebar tab: Actors
CCFUI.Settings.Tab.Items.Name: Show sidebar tab: Items
CCFUI.Settings.Tab.Journal.Name: Show sidebar tab: Journal
CCFUI.Settings.Tab.Tables.Name: Show sidebar tab: Roll Tables
CCFUI.Settings.Tab.Cards.Name: Show sidebar tab: Card Stacks
CCFUI.Settings.Tab.Playlists.Name: Show sidebar tab: Playlists
CCFUI.Settings.Tab.Compendium.Name: Show sidebar tab: Compendium Packs
CCFUI.Settings.PlayerNavByPermission.Hin: When on, a player's top scene-navigation bar lists every scene they have at least Limited ownership of, regardless of each scene's "Show in Navigation" toggle. This lets you control player navigation purely through scene ownership. When off, Foundry's default applies (the scene must have "Show in Navigation" enabled AND the player must have permission).
CCFUI.Settings.MobileMode.Name: Mobile mode
CCFUI.Settings.MobileMode.Hint: Top half of the screen shows the full canvas (locked-center, fit-to-width); bottom half is the chat sidebar with a 1.5-line input; the Stylish Action HUD is overlaid bottom-right. Auto detects mobile via viewport width and touch input.
CCFUI.Settings.MobileSahScale.Name: Mobile SAH scale
CCFUI.Settings.MobileSahScale.Hint: Scale factor for the Stylish Action HUD action-list overlay in mobile mode (0.2 – 1.0).
CCFUI.Settings.MobileSahSqueeze.Name: Mobile SAH horizontal squeeze
CCFUI.Settings.MobileSahSqueeze.Hint: Forcibly compress the SAH action-list horizontally in mobile mode (0.3 – 1.0; lower = narrower).
CCFUI.Settings.MobileSuppressLoginPopups: Auto-close floating windows that pop up on their own during the first 6s after login (changelogs, tours, module notices). Actor sheets and regular dialogs are unaffected.
CCFUI.Mobile.Send: Send (Shift+Enter also sends; Enter inserts newline)
CCFUI.SceneConfig.Backdrop.Name: Backdrop image
CCFUI.SceneConfig.Backdrop.Hint: Optional. This image is rendered behind the scene background image (with a light blur) and fills the area that would otherwise be painted with the scene's Background Color. Leave empty to disable for this scene.
CCFUI.Settings.ApngEnabled.Name: Auto-convert APNG tiles to WebM
CCFUI.Settings.ApngEnabled.Hint: When a GM saves a Tile whose image is an animated PNG (APNG), convert it in the browser to a transparent VP9 WebM and switch the tile to it, so it plays through Foundry's native video pipeline (loop/autoplay). The first conversion downloads the ffmpeg engine (~32 MB, cached afterwards). Requires file-upload permission.
CCFUI.Settings.ApngCrf.Name: WebM quality (CRF)
CCFUI.Settings.ApngCrf.Hint: VP9 constant-quality factor for the generated WebM (4–63; lower = higher quality and larger file). Default 30. Changing this re-encodes on the next save.
CCFUI.Settings.ApngPremultiply.Name: Premultiply alpha
CCFUI.Settings.ApngPremultiply.Hint: Premultiply the colour by the alpha channel during encoding. Leave off on Foundry v11.315+. Turn on only if converted tiles show a black fringe/matte around semi-transparent edges; then re-save the tile to re-encode.
CCFUI.Settings.ApngCdnBase.Name: ffmpeg CDN base URL
CCFUI.Settings.ApngCdnBase.Hint: Where the ffmpeg.wasm packages (@ffmpeg/ffmpeg, @ffmpeg/util, @ffmpeg/core) are loaded from. Defaults to unpkg.com. Point this at a self-hosted mirror for offline games or strict content-security policies.
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifyEnabled.Name: Main chat: new-message alert
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifyEnabled.Hint: Play a sound and show a red unread dot when someone else posts in the main chat channel. Your own messages and whispers you cannot read never alert.
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifyMode.Name: Main chat: when to play the sound
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifyMode.Hint: The red dot only ever appears while you are away from the window; this picks when the sound plays.
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifyMode.Away: Only when the window is in the background
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifySound.Name: Main chat: alert sound
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifySound.Hint: Audio file played on a new message. Leave blank for no sound. Default: sounds/notify.wav.
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifyVolume.Name: Main chat: alert volume
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifyVolume.Hint: 0 – 2, further scaled by Foundry's Interface volume slider. Above 1 the sound is amplified (very high values may distort).
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifyBadge.Name: Main chat: red dot on tab / taskbar
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifyBadge.Hint: While the window is in the background, put a red dot on the browser tab icon and an unread count in the title. If Foundry is installed as an app (Chrome / Edge "Install"), the taskbar icon is badged too. Clears when you return to the window.
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifyTab.Name: Main chat: channel
CCFUI.Settings.ChatNotifyTab.Hint: Name (or id) of the Multiple Chat Tabs tab that counts as the main chat. Leave blank to use the first (default) tab. Without Multiple Chat Tabs every message counts.
CCFUI.Apng.NoPerm: APNG→WebM skipped: you lack file-upload permission.
CCFUI.Export.MenuHint: Export the whole chat log as a ccfolia-style HTML log (dark theme, character icon, speaker, timestamp, dice results). If "Multiple Chat Tabs" is active, each of its channels also gets its own file, the all-channels file tags every message with its channel, and the files are downloaded as a single ZIP. Speaker colours come from each message author's Foundry user colour. GM only.
CCFUI.Export.Summary: {count} messages will be exported into {files} file(s):
CCFUI.Export.NoTabs: "Multiple Chat Tabs" is not active, so no channel split is available — every line will be tagged [main].
CCFUI.Export.NoMessages: There are no chat messages to export.
CCFUI.Export.NoPerm: Only a GM can export the chat log.
